tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i bskyed rim lam dus kyi dbang dang bcas pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul nges don rab gsal bzhugs so// bde chen dbyings las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /dmigs med snying rjes sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar/ /cir yang ngom mdzad dgyes pa rdo rje dang / /dbyer med drin can bla mas bdag skyongs shig /rtsa bshad rgyud sde gsum gyi snying po'i bcud/ /dgyes rdor mngon rtogs lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul/ /gong ma'i gsung bzhin mdo tsam 'chad la spro/ /'dir thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde kun gyi yang rtser gyur pa dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa bshad rgyud gsum gyi don gyi bcud phyung ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i thugs dam chag med bzhi'i ya gyal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mngon rtogs lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ji ltar sbyong tshul cung zad 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po la'ang gsum ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang sems kyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed pa/ sngags kyi ltung ba chen po rnams mi 'phel ba dang nyes pa phra mo thams cad sbyong ba'i phyir rdor sems bsgom bzlas byed pa'o/ /dang po'i sbyang gzhi ni spyir ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dang / khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi 'jig rten gyi dpon po/ lha klu bdud btsan sogs skyabs su 'gro bar mi 'os pa la skyabs su song ba dang / skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul la skyabs su ma song zhing ma dad pa dang ma gus pa bgyis pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa yin la/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i kye rdor lha dgu/

gtso bo'i rgyab be ta li'i mdun du gsung rab pusti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu bcas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos nas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du re sa rten gnas su 'dzin pa'i blos tshul bzhin du skyabs su 'gro ba ni sbyong byed kyi lam mo/ /sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong byed de'i ngo bor bsgyur nas de gnyis dbyer med du nyams su len pa ni sbyong tshul lo/ /spyir dag pa dang ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad/ rang gi sems nyid de dang de dag tu shar ba tsam las logs na med cing / de yang bden par ma grub pa'i gnad 'di shes na tshul 'di dag blo la bde mo zhig 'char ba yin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ spyi'i sbyang gzhi sngar dang 'dra la/ khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi ni/ tshe thog ma med pa nas gzhan la bsam ngan bsgoms pa/ sems bskyed par mi 'os pa bskyed pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed mkha' khyab kyi sems can mar shes drin dran pa sogs kyi sgo nas byams brtsesam̐ skyongam̐ zhingam̐ / des kun nas bslangs pa'i sems bskyed bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin no/ /sbyong tshul snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul te/ sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong byed de'i ngo bor bsgyur nas bsgom pa yin no/ /gsum pa rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ nad gdon sdig sgrib spyi dang khyad par gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams chag rnams yin la/ sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yin zhing / sbyong tshul gong bzhin/ zhar la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa cung zad bshad na/ rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun des sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam pa dang / bdud rtsi dmar po mar khu lta bu'i bcud dang ldan pas rlung nad dang /

bdud rtsi dkar po bsil ba'i rang bzhin gyis khrag mkhris dang / bdud rtsi bsil drod snyoms pas bad kan gyi nad rnams dang / nad thams cad rnag khrag ljan ljin sogs kyi rnam pa dang / bdud rtsi dkar po khro chu khol ba lta bu'i gseb nas rta mgrin dang phyag na rdo rje dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs khro bo'i tshogs spros pas/ gdon thams cad srog chags sdom sdig sogs kyi rnam pas 'og sgo dang rkang mthil nas ded de phyir thon par bsam pa ni thun mong ba'i dmigs pa dang / bdud rtsi'i rgyun des smin mtshams mgrin pa snying ga rkang mthil yan chad gang bas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib pa bzhi dag sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsgom pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /de nas bshags sdom byas mthar rdor sems rang la bstims nas gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam pa'i bshags pa bla na med pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la gsum gyi dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa la/ yul dag pa dang ma dag pa la brten pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ tshogs gsog pa po/ gsog yul/ bsag bya'i las rnams kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed so sor sbyar na/ rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su las gsog pa'i rten rigs drug gi lus ji snyed cig blangs pa de'ang sems snang tsam yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi sems la bag chags kyi tshul du yod pa ni sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed ma dag pa'i snang ba de nyid dag pa'i snang ba rang nyid he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug gi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi dang ldan par sgom pa yin la/ lam byed bzhi ni/ sbyang gzhi de dag lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par sgom pa rnam pa lam byed/ de kye rdo rje yin snyam pa mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi kye rdor dngos yin snyam pa 'bras bu lam byed/ de la brten nas rang rgyud kyi sgrib pa byang nas tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba byin rlabs lam byed do/

/sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi dang de las 'phros pa'i sems byung gi rgyu ba sna tshogs pa bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rim bzhin rang gi snying gar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng ngo bo kye'i rdo rje'i thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes yin pa la rnam pa hūm̐ yig gi rnam par bsgom pa dang / de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i tshogs kyis sbyong tshul 'dra/ de bzhin du sbyang gzhi rang gi las gsog pa'i yul rnams sbyong byed rdo rje lha dgu bla ma mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa dang / sbyang gzhi rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te/ yul dam pa rnams la brdeg btsog byas pa sogs ngan song du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan bsags pa nas nyan rang gi byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa'i dge ba'i las bsags pa'i bar gyi las rnams/ sbyong byed phyag 'tshal ba nas sdom pa gzung ba'i bar rnams kyis sbyong ba yin cing de yang bye brag so so'i sbyang gzhi ni rang gi skye ba snga ma rnams su ma gus pa dang ser sna'i dbang gis phyag mchod 'os pa la ma byas pa dang / mi shes pa'i dbang gis mi 'os pa'i yul la phyag mchod byas pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed tshogs zhing gi yon tan mthong ba'i dad gus kyis kun nas bslangs te sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba dang / rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kyis gtso bo nas rim bzhin mchod pa dag yin no/ /de yang gdol pa mos cang te'u'i sgras mchod pa phyi mchod/ gau ri sogs kyis bdud rtsi dang / ri khrod mas ro ste bcud len gyis mchod pa nang mchod/ g.yung mos 'khyud pa'i stangs ka byas pas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshim par bsam pa ni gsang mchod do/ /de bzhin du tshe rabs snga ma rnams su rang gis rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i nyes pa dang /

gzhan gyi dge ba la phrag dog dang bar chad byas pa dang / chos dang gang zag gi bdag tu bzung ba dang / skyabs dam pa la ma brten pa dang / gzhan don du sems ma bskyed pa dang sbyor ba phyin ci log tu spyod pa dang / dge rtsa ma bsngos pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed yan lag bdun pa'i rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas sgom pa dang / sbyang gzhi rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi sdom pa ma bzung ba dang / bzung yang nyams pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rigs lnga'i sdom bzung gi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas sgom pa yin no/ /'dis rgyu dus kyi sta gon dang yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug gi skabs su thob pa'i sdom pa rnams sor chud par byed pa yin zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la sbyang gzhi rang gis yul ma dag pa la brten nas las bsags pa dang / 'byung ba bzhi dang / tshad med bzhi'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag sbyong byed tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor bsgyur nas sbyangs 'bras lha mo bzhis rgyas btab nas nyams su len pa ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas de dag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas byams pa tshad med kyi ngo bo lha mo puk+ka si'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam/ de bzhin du 'od zer dkar po dmar po sna tshogs 'phros pas sems can rnams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms tshad med gsum gyi ngo bo lha mo ri khrod ma gdol pa mo g.yung mo rnams kyi go 'phang la rim bzhin bkod par bsam mo/ /rgyas par byed na 'od zer gyi rtse la lha mo spro bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsags kyi sbyang gzhi rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng nas sngar shi ba ma 'ongs pa na 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i bag chags ji snyed yod pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten zhig pa dang 'jig par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/

sbyong byed ye shes tshogs bsags kyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su len pa ste/ 'di ni sngags brjod pa tsam gyis stong nyid btsan thabs su bsgom pa ste/ de yang chad stong ma yin par ma dag pa'i snang ba rnams bkag nas sems kyi gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ ye shes tshogs bsags kyis 'chi ba sbyong ba'i tshul 'di mi 'thad gsungs pa'ang yod mod/ 'di tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung dang mthun par bris pa yin no/ /gsum pa srung 'khor la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi dang po'i sbyang gzhi ni/ ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang / rang gi chos sgrub pa'i gegs dang bar chad nad gdon nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa rang gi sems kyi rnam rol du shes par byas nas/ sbyong byed ye shes lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas sgom pa ni spang bya gnyen por shar ba'am bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag bya ba yin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / bcud kyi sems can skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa dang / lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsam pa nar son pa/ rang gi mnga' thang la dbang bsgyur ba/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi bya ba sna tshogs byed pa rnams/ rim bzhin rten srung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu par sgom pa dang / lha dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang / ye shes pa bstim pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa dang / zab pa'i gnad lnga'i dmigs pa rnams kyis sbyong ba yin no/ /gnad lnga gzhan rnams dkyus su gsal zhing / sngags bzla ba'i gnad ni/ na maḥs man+ta sogs nas tsakra warta'i bar rang nyid gtso bo gtsug tor 'khor sgyur du gsal 'debs shing gzhan rnams dran tsam bya/

sarba yan+t+ra nas sarban+tu'i bar dgra bgegs rnams gsal 'debs/ tshin+dha nas mā ra'i bar 'khor los dgra bgegs rnams gtub par bsam/ hūm̐ bcus khro bo bcu dang / phaṭ gsum gyis steng 'og bar gsum gyi khro bo rnams ched du gsal 'debs par gsungs so/ /mdor na skye ba snga ma rnams su gzhan la gnod 'tshe byas pa dang / gzhan gyis chos sgrub pa la bar chad bgyis pa'i las gzugs phyi rol tu dgra bgegs kyi rnam par shar ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen por rang sems rig stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid de'i thabs gsal ba'i cha lha sku dang / shes rab stong pa'i cha rdo rje rwa gur dang mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i rnam par shar nas/ des las ngan gyi rang gzugs gnod byed rnams tshar bcad nas chos nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam pa ni gnad do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la spyi'i don dang / yan lag gi don gnyis las dang po la lnga las/ dang po sbyang gzhi ni/ lha'i ngo bor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas lhar 'gyur ba'i gzhi yang yin/ tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyong ba'i gzhi yang yin pas/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam par snang ba'i kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad do/ /gnyis pa sbyang bya ni chos de dag lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bor ma shes par 'di ni gzugs so/ /'di ni tshor ba'o zhes sogs tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa rnams so/ /sbyang gzhi dang sbyang bya de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ de gnyis ngo bo tha dad du 'dod pa dang gzhi gcig la ldog pas dbye bar bzhed pa'i lugs gnyis las rang lugs phyi ma yin/ gsum pa sbyong byed ni rnam thar sgo gsum byang phyogs so bdun ye shes lnga rigs lnga yum lnga la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa sbyong tshul sbyang gzhi phung khams skye mched kyi chos thams cad sbyong byed ye shes lnga rigs lnga la sogs pa'i ngo bor shes par byas nas mnyam bzhag gi skabs su ye shes tshogs bsags kyis dngos po thams cad stong nyid du sbyangs nas de'i ngang las tha mal pa'i snang ba 'char du mi 'jug par rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas de kun rdzob kyi snang ba dang dbyer med du sgom pa dang /

rjes spyod kyi tshe snang ba'i dngos po thams cad la tha mal du 'dzin pa rang shugs kyis skye ba'i tshe dran pas zin par byas nas lha dang ye shes su sgom par byed pa'o/ /lnga pa sbyangs 'bras ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ba rnams dag pa'i snang bar bsgoms pas glo bur gyi dri ma dag nas chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku'i ngo bor gnas gyur pa'o/ /de yang chos gcig la mtshon na sbyang gzhi gzugs phung / sbyong byed rnam snang ngam gzugs rdo rje ma/ sbyang bya 'di ni gzugs so snyam pa'i tha mal du 'dzin pa/ sbyong tshul snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis sbyang ba/ sbyangs 'bras rnam snang ngam gzugs rdo rje ma'i go 'phang gnas 'gyur gyi tshul du thob pa'o/ /'di bzhin du kun la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bye brag lha'i rnal 'byor gyis skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong ba la/ slob bshad pa rnams dus gsum gyi skye 'chi bar do'i snang ba thams cad rang sems la bag chags kyi tshul du yod pas de thams cad sbyang gzhir bzhed cing / gzhan du rang gzhan mkhas pa kha cig sna tshogs gsungs pa 'dir ma spros/ gnyis pa la yan lag drug gi/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam snang gi yan lag la'ang bzhi yod pa'i dang po gzhi'i yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni ma'i mngal/ sgo nga / me tog sogs dang / sa gzhi la sogs pa rang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba'i ma dag pa'i skye gnas bzhi po de dag gi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin rnam pa chos 'byung gru gsum du bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin/ gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub pa'i rgyu rlung / me/ chu/ sas bsdus pa rnams te mdor na 'byung bzhir snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad/ sbyong byed rlung lha mo sgrol ma/ me gos dkar mo/ chu ma ma ki/ sa sangs rgyas spyan ma bzhi'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor so so'i rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi dang ldan par bsgom pa ste/

gcig la mtshon na ma dag pa'i rlung de lha mo g.yung mo'am sgrol ma'i ngo bo rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pa rnam pa lam byed/ de la lha mo de nyid du mos pa mos pa lam byed/ de yang 'bras dus kyi lha mo sgrol ma dngos yin snyam pa ni 'bras bu lam byed/ thabs des tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur ba ni byin rlabs lam byed do/ /gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs 'gre/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du de byin gyis rlobs byed kyi rnam snang gi ngo bo 'khor lo sgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ gzhal yas khang rnam snang gi yan lag tu 'jog sla ba'i ched yin la/ sbyang gzhi ni/ 'og gnas thabs kyi yan lag gi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa rkyen gyi yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ rang gi sems la ma dag pa'i bar dor snang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum oṃ dkar po āḥdamar po hūm̐ mthing kha gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ steng du ho mgo thur du bstan pa/ 'og tu ho mgo gyen la bstan pa gnyis dmar po sred len dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed kye rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs dang thabs shes gnyis kyi ngo bor yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par bsgom/ de las de 'dra ba'i yig 'bru lnga pa gcig chad de 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim pa'i rkyen gyis gzhal yas khang grub par bsam/ bzhi pa gnas thabs kyi yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gzugs phung sa khams kha dog dkar po rnam snang gi rigs mig shes sogs dang ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten gyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed byang phyogs so bdun rnam snang gi ngo bo gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bsgyur nas bsgom pa yin no/ /zhar la dur khrod kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ phyi ltar na phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi dur khrod brgyad/ nang ltar na sna bug gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i lus kyi bu ga brgyad/ gsang ba ltar na 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog la sogs pa'o/

/sbyong byed ma dag pa ltar snang yang ma dag pa ma yin par dag pa ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad do/ /gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa gsal por bsgoms mthar sngags don la nga rgyal 'dzin pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas gzhal yas khang 'di ni bdag nyid rnam snang gi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa gzhal yas khang du shar ba'o snyam du nga rgyal 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag la gnyis/ lha dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang / sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ nyi zer du phung po lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga/ rtsa yi ge bdud rtsi rlung nad gdon rnams lnga lnga/ lus ngag yid yon tan bya ba dang bcas pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dbyings dang bcas pa/ skye gnas bzhi po re re la'ang lnga lngar phye nas mngon byang lnga dang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul zhib tu gsungs kyang de tsam las dang po pa rnams kyis blos 'dzin mi nus par 'dug pas/ 'dir skye gnas sbyong tshul tsam bshad na/ sbyang gzhi mngal skyes kyi pha'i khams/ drod gsher skyes kyi gsher/ sgong skyes kyi pha/ rdzus skyes kyi stong pa'i cha la sogs pa/ sbyong byed mtshan bzang po so gnyis kyi ngo bo ā li g.yas bskor gyis bcu drug de'i nang du g.yon bskor gyis ā li bcu drug zhu ba la byung ba'i me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bsgyur nas lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin no/ /de bzhin du mngal skyes kyi ma'i khams dang / drod gsher skyes kyi drod/ sgong skyes kyi ma/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal ba'i cha la sogs pa/ sbyong byed dpe byed brgyad cu'i rang bzhin kā li 'god lugs snga ma ltar phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par sgom pa dang /

skye gnas bzhir skye ba len pa'i bar do'i rnam shes kyi cha rnams/ sbyong byed sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa'i rnam par sgoms/ sbyang gzhi mngal skyes dang sgong skyes kyi khu khrag dang bar srid 'dres pa dang / drod gsher skyes kyi drod gsher dang bar srid 'dres pa/ rdzus skyes kyi gsal stong tsam dang bar srid 'dres pa'i cha rnams/ sbyong byed bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i thig le dmar skya'i rnam par bsgom/ sbyang gzhi skye gnas bzhir skye ba blangs pa'i lus grub pa'i gnas skabs rnams/ sbyong byed chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bskyed pas sbyong ba yin no/ /mngon byang gi go rim ni pha'i khams dkar cha 'og tu 'phen/ ma'i khams dmar cha steng du 'phen/ de gnyis kyi bar du bar do'i rnam shes zhugs/ de gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa de las lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang mthun pas so/ /gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba la sbyor ba 'du shes gsum ldan du sgom pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ tha mal pa'i chags pa skye ba'i yul skyes pa dang bud med du snang ba dang / pho mo'i mtshan mar snang ba dang / 'dzag bde la zhen nas 'khrig pa spyod 'dod kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum du bskyed pa lha'i 'du shes dang / mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa sngags kyi 'du shes dang / thabs 'di la brten nas lha mo rnams spros la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes gsum gyis sbyong / sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i spun zla dang ming sring du snang ba dang / de rnams kyi bar srid dang khu khrag 'dres pa/ mngal gyi gnas skabs 'phel ba dang / lus grub pa dang / phyir btsas pa rnams rim bzhin/ sbyong byed snyoms 'jug gi bde ba'i sgras spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum kyi zhal du zhugs pa thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas thig le brgyad dang /

de sa bon brgyad dang / de lha mo brgyad dang / de dag sbyor mtshams nas phyir phyung ste phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du 'khod par bsam pas sbyong ba yin no/ /bye brag lha mo so so'i sbyang gzhi ni rim bzhin/ gzugs tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po bzhi/ sbyong byed me long / mnyam nyid/ sor rtog bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo gau ri sogs phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang / sbyang gzhi sa chu me rlung bzhi/ sbyong byed tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo mtshams kyi lha mo puk+ka si sogs bzhis sbyong ba yin no/ /sbyang gzhi dug lnga/ sbyong byed ye shes lnga'i ngo bo kha dog lnga'i rnam par shar ba yin snyam pa'i sgo nas lha so so'i sku mdog gi dag bya dang dag byed sbyor ba dang / sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa dug lnga/ sbyong byed ye shes lnga'i ngo bo lha so so'i phyag mtshan rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri la sogs pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas sgom pa yin pas/ 'di dag gong 'og kun tu dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa thig ler zhu ba'i sbyang gzhi ni/ ma dag pa'i sems snang la pha ma nyal po byed par snang ba'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas sbyong / sbyang gzhi rang gi bar srid byas pa dang byed 'gyur thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum sred len dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed kye rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs thabs shes kyi ngo bo yig 'bru lnga'i rnam par shar bas sbyong / sbyang gzhi rang gi bar srid dang pha ma'i khu khrag 'dres pa/ sbyong byed rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi phung khams skye mched yig 'bru lnga rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pas sbyong / de nas rang nyid ngo bo bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin yin pa la/ rnam pa thig le sngo skya'i rnam par gnas pa'i nga rgyal bzung nas sngags brjod cing mnyam par bzhag

de'i sbyang gzhi phung khams lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa/ chos khams/ yid dbang / rdor sems kyi rigs kha dog nag po la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rdor sems kyi ngo bo thig le'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su len pa ste/ spyir skabs 'di'i sbyang gzhi 'di dag rdor sems kyi yan lag spyi'i sbyang gzhi yin mod/ 'dir sbyar ba ni thig ler zhu ba 'di nyid rdor sems yan lag gi dngos gzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'i sbyang gzhi ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs su sas brtan/ chus sdud/ mes smin/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa rnams sbyong byed 'byung ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo lha mo bzhis klus bskul bas sbyong / mngal gyi gnas skabs su mer mer po la sogs pa thig le sa bon du gyur pas sbyong / lus rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa sa bon las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs pas sbyong ba yin/ skul byed glu'i tshig don ni/ rje btsun kye rdo rje snying rje'i yid kyis gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shig puk+ka sī ni bdag dang sems can thams cad la skyobs/ ji ltar skyob na/ stong pa'i rang bzhin thig le 'di nyid spangs la/ bdag la bde ba chen po'i 'dod pa sbyor ba bzhed par mdzod cig ri khrod mas/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pa ste 'chi bar 'gyur bas kye rdo rje khyod gzugs kyi skur bzhengs shig de yang zhal phyag gis stong pa'i rang bzhin thig le 'di nyid spangs la/ ri khrod ma bdag gi re ba'i 'bras bu 'grub par mdzod/ gdol pa mos/ dga' gtso zhes bos nas slob lam du bdag sangs rgyas nas sems can rnams bde ba la dgod par bya'o zhes 'gro ba rnams mgron du gnyer te dam bcas nas/ da ltar stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci ste bzhugs par mi rigs so/ /khyod med na bdag gis gzhan don phyogs tsam yang ni mi 'tshal bas gdol pa mo bdag gis gtso bo thig le las bzhengs par zhu ba bgyid pa'o/

/g.yung mo bdag gis sna tshogs su snang ba'i khyod kyi thugs g.yo sgyu dang bcas par 'tshal gyi/ sprul pa sna tshogs mig 'phrul lta bu mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig g.yung mo bdag nyid dran pa nyams par 'gyur bas 'di la snying rje rgyun chad med par mdzod cig ces so/ /zhal phyag gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ni/ zhal brgyad kyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad sbyong / phyag bcu drug gis skye mched bcu gnyis skye rga na 'chi dang bcas pa sbyong / spyan nyer bzhis dbang po nyer gnyis gsal stong gnyis dang bcas pa sbyong / zhabs bzhis skye gnas bzhi sbyong / mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal gyis nyer len gyi phung po la brten nas sdug bsngal 'khor mor 'byung ba sbyong zhing / de bzhin du khro bo'i skur bzhengs pas zhe sdang sbyong / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pas 'dod chags sbyong / mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur bsgoms pas gti mug sbyang ba sogs kyang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs kyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ni/ sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum/ sbyong byed kye rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon bsgom pa ye shes sems dpa' dang / de'i steng du thig le bsgom pa ting 'dzin sems dpa' ste sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pas sbyong / sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad sbyong byed thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gsal bar byas pas sbyong / sbyang gzhi ma dag pa'i skye mched drug dang gnas gsum du 'dzin pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed gnas de dag tu gti mug rdo rje la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams sgom pas sbyong ba'o/ /sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i sems ye shes pa dgug gzhug gis sbyong ba yin no/ /bstod pa'i don ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo khyod ni bdag med ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod pa'o/ /khyod ni de kho na nyid kyi don thugs su chud pas chos sku'i dngos grub kyi mchog brnyes pa'o/ /khyod kyi phrin las kyis rgyu ba sems can dang / mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten na gnas pa'i 'gro ba kun brgyan pas te kun gyi don sgrub shing / de yang rgyu dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can rnams sdug bsngal las sad pa ste sgrol bar mdzad pa'o/ /tshul ji ltar na sgyu ma'i spros pa ste gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pas rdo rje ste chos sku'i go 'phang sgrub par mdzad cing bzhed pa'i yid can no/ /mdor na he ru ka dpal rdo rje stong pa nyid dang yid kyi dges pa chen po 'gyur med kyi bde ba brnyes pa bde stong zung 'jug gi lha kye rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /lus dkyil sgom pa 'di'ang rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag tu 'dus par gsungs pas 'dir bshad na/ spyir rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa/ lha ye shes pa bcug pa'i rkyen gyis lha khang mun pa can du sgron me btegs pa ltar gsal bar byas pa rim gyis gsal 'debs par byed pa yin gyi/ blos sgro btags nas spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje sogs su sgom pa ma yin te/ 'khor 'das la yod tshad sems la bag chags kyis tshul du tshang zhing / de lus la smin par bzhed pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bden grub tu bsam par mi bya'o/ /'di la rten dang brten pa gnyis las/ dang po'i sbyang gzhi ni/ rang gi spyi bo rkang mthil sogs kyi sha rus chu ser sogs/ sbyong byed gnas de dag tu ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs su sgom pa dang /

de bzhin du rkang pa'i long bu'i tshig mtshams/ sum mdo/ lto ba/ snying ga rnams kyi sha rus sogs lha mo bzhi'i ngo bo 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par sgom pa dang / sgal tshig nyer gcig dang / mig rna ba sna lce la sogs pa lus kyi cha shas de dag ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i ri rab nyer gcig dang / gzhal yas khang gi cha shas rnams su sgom pa ste/ de yang he ru ka snang stong 'od kyi rang bzhin can de'i sku'i gnas de dang der gcig gi go sa gcig gis ma bkag par me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa lha'i dag bya dag byed ni/ rang gi sems kun gzhi'i steng na tshor ba'i phung po/ nga rgyal ser sna sa khams sogs kyi bag chags ji snyed yod pa de lus la lte ba'i rtsa 'khor 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yi ge khams dang bcas pa'i rnam par smin pa ni sbyong byed rin 'byung yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bsgom pa ste/ de yang rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba'i rtsa yig gi nang gi khams gtso bo dang / phyi shun gyi rtsa dang / der rgyu ba'i lte ba'i rlung rnams gtso mo dang phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab rnams 'khor gyi lha mo rnams su bsgom pa ni/ 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du sbyang gzhi rang gi sems la 'du byed kyi phung po/ phrag dog rlung gi khams sogs kyi bag chags yod pa de/ lus la smin pa gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor yi ge khams dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed don grub gtso 'khor gyi rnam par bsgom pa dang / rnam shes kyi phung po/ zhe sdang chu khams sogs kyi bag chags lus la smin pa snying kha'i rtsa 'khor yi ge khams dang bcas pa mi bskyod pa gtso 'khor du bsgom pa dang / rnam shes kyi phung po/ 'dod chags me khams sogs kyi bag chags lus la smin pa'i mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor khams yi ge dang bcas pa 'od dpag med gtso 'khor du bsgom pa dang / gzugs phung /

gti mug nam mkha'i khams sogs kyi bag chags lus la smin pa spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor yi ge khams dang bcas pa rnam snang gtso 'khor du bsgom pas sbyong ba yin no/ /rang gi sems la ma dag pa'i skye mched dang tshigs chen brgyad la sogs pa'i bag chags ji snyed yod pa rnams/ lus kyi gnas mig la sogs par rtsa yig mam̐ la sogs pa'i rnam par smin pa ni sbyong byed gti mug rdo rje ma sogs skye mched kyi lha mo rnams dang khro bo rnams bsgom pa ste/ yul gyi lha mo rnams kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ mig shes sogs gzugs sogs la 'jug pa'i rkyen du gyur pa'i rlung rnams yin no/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag la dbang bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang la/ spyi dang bye brag gi dag bya dag byed gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyang gzhi lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor la sbyong byed bum dbang bskur ba'i thabs kyis sbyang bas sbyangs 'bras sprul sku mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la slob ma'i dbang dang / slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/ dang po la sbyor ba'i skabs gsol 'debs kyi tshig don ni/ byang chub rdo rje ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnam snang sogs so/ /des da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sogs la mchod chen dbang ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ bdag kyang 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ nam mkha' dang po nas yod kyang rtsig pa la sogs pa'i sgrib byed bsal ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' skyes zhes tha snyad 'dogs pa ltar sems nyid thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' chen po dang po nas yod kyang glo bur gyi dri ma bsal ba'i tshe/ skye ba'i tha snyad dang ldan pa ni rdo rje 'chang yin la/ de'i ngo bo slob dpon gyis deng 'dir bdag la dbang bskur bstsal du gsol zhes pa'o/ /dag bya dag byed dngos la rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i sbyang gzhi rang rgyud kyi phung po lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga 'byung ba lnga rnams sbyong byed rigs lnga ye shes lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor/

sbyong tshul snang ba bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis bsgom pa'o/ /de yang mi bskyod pa chu dbang lta bu la mtshon na sbyang gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po zhe sdang chu khams rnams la tha mal du 'dzin pa spangs nas lhag pa'i lha mi bskyod pa dang me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bor shes par byed pa ste/ de yang thabs ji lta bu'i zhe na/ bla mas bdag dang dbang rdzas bum pa'i chu gnyis ka yan lag dang po gsum lhan cig bzhengs pa so sor 'grub pa'i sgo nas mi bskyod par bskyed de dbang rdzas kyi lha bum chu'i rnam par zhu ba des bla ma he ru ka gtso bo bcas kyis rdo rje'i glu len shis pa brjod bgegs bskrad mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas rang gi rnam shes kyi phung po gtso bor gyur pa'i phung khams skye mched la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i sa bon 'debs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /dbang don ngo sprod byed dngos kun gang dang gang snang sogs kyi tshig don ni/ phung po lnga nyon mongs pa lnga la sogs pa dngos po kun gang tshogs drug gi yul du gang dang gang snang ba de rnams gtso bo de rang gi lhag pa'i lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i ngo bor shes par bya ste/ de yang rigs lnga ma yin pa la yin par shes pa min te/ chos can gyi chos kun rigs lnga'i ngo bor rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa med cing rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa de cho ga 'dis bsal bar byas pas lam sgom pa'i dus su tha mal du 'dzin pa spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su blta bar gyis shig ces pa'o/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi sbyang gzhi ni/ phung po lnga'i chos nyid la byed pa yin kyang / 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag la snang ba'i chos nyid mtshan nyid pa ni sbyang gzhir mi rung bas/ tha mal pa'i blo la chos can dang chos nyid gnyis su snang ba'i chos nyid de sbyang gzhi yin par gsungs shing /

sbyong byed sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par bsgoms nas/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi don du bla mas tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas te hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rang gi lag g.yas su gtad par bsam pa ste/ tshigs bcad kyi don ni/ 'di de sangs rgyas lnga po thams cad 'dus pa yin cing / de nyid mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje ni/ rigs drug pa'i phyag na gnas pa de/ slob ma khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs shig des rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te dam tshig brtan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /don du tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la zhugs par gyis shig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la gsol 'debs kyi tshig don ni/ theg pa dman pa'i sa la phyir mi ldog cing mnyam rjes med par 'khor ba ni sa brgyad pa yin la/ de dang skal pa mnyam pa'i dbang bskur phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i dbang de mgon po slob dpon gyis bdag la bstsal nas kyang ni de nas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang / lha'i de kho na nyid dang / slob dpon gyi phrin las rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa'i las yin pas bstan du gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa bla na med pa slob dpon gyi dbang gi skabs su thob pa'i sdom pa de'ang bstsal du gsol zhes pa'o/ /dag bya dag byed dngos ni sbyang gzhi rang gi tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum/ sbyong byed bla mas dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i sgo nas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du ngo sprod cing rang gis kyang de ltar shes pas sbyong ba yin la/ de yang rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ 'di de sogs kyi tshig don gong bzhin thog mtha' med pa sogs kyis rdo rje'i de kho na nyid ngo sprod pa ste/ tshig don ni/ thog mar skye ba dang mtha' mar 'gag pa med pa'i bdag nyid can thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la chags pas sems dpa' ni stong nyid bcu drug gi rang bzhin yin pas rdo rje sems dpa'/

sems can gyi don la dgyes pas dga' ba che/ nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas kun tu bzang po/ dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pas kun bdag nyid/ de'i phyag rgya dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po dang rigs lnga po thams cad kyi bdag po yin no zhes pa'o/ /don du phyi rdzas kyi rdo rje sbyin pa'i sgo nas rang gi sems chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi bdag nyid du ngo sprod pa yin no/ /de nas dril bu gsung gi dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ 'di ni rnal 'byor sogs dril bu rang gi lag g.yon du gtad par bsams la/ tshig don ni dril bu 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi dril bu'i sgra ste gsung dbyangs rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba de nyid kyi rjes su 'gro bar bshad pa ste/ gsung de mtshon byed yin pas khyod kyis kyang ni rang gi ngag grags stong skye med kyi rang bzhin de lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas dril bu 'di nyid rtag tu zungs shig dang byang chub kyi mchog tu phyin par 'gyur ba rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzhed par mdzad pa ltar gyis shig ces pa'o/ /āḥ srid pa sogs kyis dril bu'i de kho na nyid ngo sprod pa ste/ de'i don ni srid pa ste ma dag pa ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa yin no/ /de yang ngo bo nyid kyi srid pa dang bral ba ste rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'o/ /de ltar rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i tshul 'di shes pa'i sems dang ldan pa de ni srid pa dam par byed par 'gyur te/ srid pa'i skyon gyis 'ching bar mi 'gyur zhes pa'i don no snyam mo/ /don du phyi rdzas kyi dril bu sbyin pa'i sgo nas rang gi ngag grags stong skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin du ngo sprod pa yin par shes dgos so/

/rang nyid rdo rje 'chang yab yum du bskyed pa ni phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig sbyin pa'i don te/ shes rab bcu drug sogs kyis de ltar dran par gyis shig ces bsgo ba lta bu yin la/ tshig don ni shes rab ma lo bcu drug lon pa la slob ma rdo rje 'chang du bskyed pa'i lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya sku dang / gnyis med ye shes kyi mtshon byed du rdo rje sbyin pa la rdo rje thugs dang / gsung grags stong skye ba med pa mtshon byed dril bu sbyin pa dril bu gsung gi dam tshig ste/ dam tshig gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang du rab tu brjod do zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje che dang sogs kyis de kho na nyid dang rjes gnang mdor bsdus pa ste/ tshig don ni rdo rje che dang zhes pa thugs kyi dam tshig dang / dril bu che zhes pa gsung gi dam tshig ste de gnyis zungs shig rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyis skur byin gyis brlabs pa ste bskyed pa sku'i dam tshig ste/ de gsum byin pa'i dus de ring nyid nas rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa yin pas slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis shig ces so/ /phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par brjod pa ni/ srid pa'i bde ba sogs te don ni/ srid pa'i bde ba ni shin tu chung ste/ sdug bsngal phyi ma gnyis kyis bsdus pas so/ /sdug bsngal chen po rnam par dag pa'i phyir shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs su gyur pa rdo rje 'chang kha sbyor gyi sku bsgom pa'i dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis longs shig 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du rang gi lhag pa'i lhar shes pa'i sbyor ba yis bdag dang gzhan rdo rje 'chang chen por shes pa la mchod par bya ste/ des tshogs rdzogs nas rdo rje 'chang kha sbyor gyi sku 'thob pa las mi 'da'o/

/rang gi yid stong pa nyid btsun mor sprul nas bsten pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang la sbyor ba'i skabs su bstod pa'i tshig don ni bshad zin la/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig don ni/ bcom ldan 'das nyon mongs pa kun zhi ba chen po kye zhes slob dpon la bos nas/ rdo rje de rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid zag med bde ba'i rnal 'byor dang dbyer med gcig tu grub par mdzad pa po/ rtog pas mi phyed pa'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa po/ de'ang rdo rje de stong pa nyid dang zag med bde ba'i rnal 'byor las byung ba ji ltar slob dpon khyod ni bdag nyid chen po dang / ye shes kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa de bzhin du bdag la'ang de ltar 'gyur bar mdzod/ 'khor ba las nyon kyi 'dam gyi tshogs nang du bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs shig ces pa'o/ /dag bya dag byed dngos ni/ sbyang gzhi ngag 'byung ba'i gnas mgrin pa na/ ya ra la wa'i yi ge 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rten du yod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa yi ge'i dkyil 'khor la/ sbyong byed gsang dbang bskur ba'i thabs kyis sbyang bas/ sbyangs 'bras longs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs kyi tshig don ni/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis byang chub kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams la kun rdzob khu ba'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur ba ltar bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis khyod la dbang bskur bar bya ste/ de'ang rdzas byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bar bya'o zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi sbyang gzhi khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la/ sbyong byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'i thabs kyis sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/

/dga' ster sogs kyi don ni/ ye shes dga' ba bzhi ster zhing de'i gnas skad cig ma bzhi ster ba'i lha mo 'di ni ri dwags can ma la sogs pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can skyon dang bral ba'i yid 'ong ma ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i tshig lan gnyis khyer cig gang gis na slob ma la sems dpa' che zhes bos pas so/ /ji byed na khyer la snyoms 'jug gi sgo nas mchod pa dag tu gyis shig ces pa'o/ /bshang gci dag ni sogs kyi don ni/ lha mos khyod bshang gci dang khu grag dang sha chen te bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang / phyag rgya bud med la gus pa byed pa sogs la spro'am zhes dris pa la/ rang gis spro'o zhes lan 'debs pa ste go sla'o/ /e ma ni ngo mtshar ba'i tshig yin la/ nga yi pad+ma 'di ni bde ba dga' ba bzhi po thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas yin zhing / gal te 'du shes sum ldan gyi sgo nas thig le bzung ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ de'i mdun na bdag 'dug ste 'bras bu sangs rgyas myur du thob par byed pas sangs rgyas ster ba la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams pad+ma 'dis ji lta ba bzhin byed do/ /bde chen rgyal po sangs rgyas thob pa ni rang la rag las pa nyid de/ de yang phyag rgya bsten pa la ltos dgos pas pad+ma 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs zhes dang / blun po so skye dang nyan thos gang zhig phyag rgya 'di spong ba de la mchog gi dngos grub 'thob pa'i thabs gzhan med do zhes pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa la/ sbyang gzhi snying po rlung gi dkyil 'khor ram rlung sems la/ sbyong byed dbang bzhi pa bskur ba'i thabs kyis/ sbyangs 'bras ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /ye shes 'di ni sogs kyi don ni/ ye shes 'di ni dpe dang gtan tshigs sogs kyis rtogs par dka' bas ches phra zhing / rtog pas mi phyed pas rdo rje/ mtha' dbus dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ nyon mongs pa dang bral bas rdul bral/

sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sbyin pas mthar phyin/ gdod nas ma skyes pas zhi ba nyid dang / rang rgyud la ye shes bskyed pa rang la rag las pas khyod rang yang ni de yi pha zhes pa'o/ /mdor na rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab nas sngags don la nga rgyal 'dzin pa yan chad dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag yin la/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni/ rnam shes kyi phung po zhe sdang chu khams kha dog sngon po mi bskyod pa'i rigs la sogs pa sbyong byed dbang bskur ba'i rnam pa ltar snang yang ngo bo mi bskyod par shes pa'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyong ba yin no/ /bzhi pa bdud rtsi myong ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ 'du shes kyi phung po me khams kha dog dmar po 'dod chags 'od dpag med kyi rigs la sogs pa dang / ma dag pa'i zas la longs spyod pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rnam pa bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor ltar snang yang ngo bo 'od dpag med du shes pa'i thabs kyis sbyong ba yin no/ /lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ 'du byed kyi phung po rlung khams kha dog ljang gu phrag dog don grub kyi rigs sogs dang / rang la gzhan gyis bkur sti byed pa sogs kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed rnam pa mchod pa'i rnal 'byor ltar snang yang ngo bo don yod grub par shes pa'i thabs kyis sbyong ba yin no/ /drug pa bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag gi sbyang gzhi ni/ tshor ba'i phung po nam mkha'i khams nga rgyal dang ser sna kha dog ser po rin 'byung gi rigs la sogs pa dang / rang la gzhan gyis bstod pa brjod pa sogs kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ sbyong byed bstod pa'i rnam par shar yang ngo bo rin 'byung yin par shes pa'i thabs kyis sbyong ba yin no/ /gsum pa rjes mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa la/

dag pa dran pa la/ mtshon byed la dag par bzhag pa dang / ngo bo nyid la dag par bzhag pa gnyis las/ sku'i dag pa phal cher snga ma ltar yin la/ gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te sogs ni/ ngo bo nyid la dag par bzhag ste/ de'i sbyang gzhi ni sbyong byed kyi tshig zin ltar ro/ /gzhan yang sbyang gzhi tha mal pa'i smra brjod la sogs pa/ sbyong byed bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyong ba dang / snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa dang / bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba dkyil 'khor bsdu rim gyis sbyong ba dang / tha mal pa'i kha zas la longs spyod pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor gyis sbyong ba dang / nyal zhing gnyid log pa dang de las ldang ba'i sems snang rnams nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor gyis sbyong ba dang / tha mal pa'i spyod lam sna tshogs kyi sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas ci dang ci snang ba'i dngos po rnams lhar shes pa'i sgo nas lha la lha thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod pa'i thabs kyis sbyong ba la sogs pa ste/ zhib par gzhan du btsal lo/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod par byas nas/ lam dus thun bzhi la sogs pa ma chags par nyams su blangs na rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur du 'thob par 'gyur te/ sga ston spring yig tu/ spyir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod cing bsgoms na sgom pa la brtson rung mi brtson rung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bdag sgrol gzhan sgrol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes dang / 'di rgyun du thun bzhir bsgoms na thog mar yun ring por 'gor ba snyam byed de byang na yun ci yang mi 'gor/ 'di ma chag par bsgoms na phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa yin/ dbang bskur yang gzhan las nod mi dgos/ rdul mtshon dang bris sku la brten nas bum pa bcas te sgrub mchod bdag 'jug kyang zur du bya mi dgos/ 'di nyid la thams cad tshang ba yin no zhes gsungs so/

/bdag gi bla ma chos rje gzhan phan pas kyang sa skya pa rnams lam dus kyi dbang rgyun du len pa 'dis rtsa ltung sor chud par nus la rtsa ltung gis ma gos na skye ba bcu drug nas 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pas/ khe che la nyen chung ba'i lam 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas skal ldan rnams kyis de lta bu'i 'bras bu 'byung bar shes nas tshul 'di la brtson pa ni gnad dam par rtogs shing bslab par bya'o/ /slar smras pa/ kun rdzob snang ba ma dag lcags kyi khams/ /bde chen dag pa'i snang ba gser bzang por/ /skad cig nyid la sgyur ba'i thabs kyi mchog /lam 'dir mi gus blo ldan su zhig yod/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi la dbang bzhi legs bskur nas/ /'gros bzhi thim nas sku bzhi mngon mdzad pa'i/ /dbang bzhi'i lam bzang thun bzhir sgom pa 'di/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon brgyud pa'i bka' srol yin/ /de phyir 'don chog tsam zhig shes pa yis/ /yon tan rdzogs so snyam du mi sems par/ /'khrul zad rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la/ /thos bsam bsgom pas tshul bzhin 'jug par rigs/ /de ltar na yang sngon byon gong ma'i gsung / /byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i nyin byed la/ /snyigs ma'i skal chad 'ug pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /de dag rnams ni rgyab kyis phyogs par snang / /des na thos nyung blo dman bdag 'dra yis/ /bshad kyang gzhan gyis 'dzin par mi 'gyur mod/ /'on kyang bdag gi byang chub bar gyi skyabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /ngan rtog dri mas rnam par ma sbags par/ /mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin mdo tsam bshad pa la/ /nongs par gyur gang dpal ldan bla ma dang / /ye shes spyan ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'chags/ /dge ba gang des tshe rabs thams cad du/ /lam 'dir 'jug pa'i skal bzang rnyed pa dang / /chos kyi rgyal po 'jam mgon bla ma yi/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i 'bangs su 'gyur bar shog

/ces pa 'di ni nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bor stsal ba lhur blangs te/ rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i ban+de kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis skye dgu don grub gling du sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 22 sde ston a 'jam/ kye rdor bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyong tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 21
